Commentary.Commentary: For Zimbabwe, the overcast conditions helped their fast bowlers to move the ball both ways. However, a wicket evaded them till the 25th over. They kept the run rate under check for the most part but towards the end, they ended up leaking more than they would have liked. Except for Chamu Chibhabha, all the other bowlers added their names to the wickets column. Their fielding and catching looked pretty good as well. This is going to be a challenging chase for the hosts considering the conditions and the sluggish looking pitch, plus their inexperienced batting line-up. The action starts after the break, see you on the other side.

Pakistan have done it. They have turned the snail-paced innings into something good at the end. The opening duo of Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq put on 113 runs off 146 balls and put them in a strong position. After the former fell to debutant Liam Roche, Imam strung two 50-run partnerships, first with the comeback man Babar Azam and  then Shoaib Malik and got to his second ODI ton. A quickfire 46 off 25 balls from the debutant Asif Ali ensured that the total reached 308.
Full and wide, Ahmed cuts it to deep point and comes back for the second. PAKISTAN END WITH 308/7 after their 50 overs.
Great bowling. Full on off, a yorker, Ahmed does well to get his bat to ball.
Short ball on middle and leg, Khan pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sarfraz hands his partner the strike by playing the ball to the off side.
Fuller ball on off, Ahmed cuts it through point for a brace.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it around off, Shadab walks across and looks to work it away, but does not make any contact and the ball hits his pad. They take the leg bye.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on.
Gets on the back foot and flicks it to the on side for another single.
Opens the face of the bat and gets it to third man for a run.
FOUR! Ahmed has played it fine down the leg side. The ball has crossed the ropes. The umpire signals a boundary.
Shadab Khan is the next batsman in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Pakistan are losing too many wickets too quickly. A short ball around off, Hasan Ali looks to hoick it across but ends up skying it in the air. Musakanda takes an easy catch at mid-wicket.
A length ball hits Ahmed on his pads, a leg bye is stolen.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for a brace.
Short of a length on off, edged to the keeper but it just drops in front of him.
Hasan Ali is the next batsman in.

OUT! Lofted again but this time Ali mistimes it. A fullish ball just outside off, he lifts it with a short hand jab but Tiripano comes in running from long off and takes a forward diving catch to send him packing. A nice cameo from Ali, this.
Wide! The ball is too wide on the off side for Ali to make any contact.
And this one lands safely in the third man region. Ali flashes his bat at the length ball. It lobs in the air but no harm done. Two runs taken.
Ahmed opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
Outside off, cut through cover-point for a run.
Sarfraz Ahmed makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Ashraf is gone. What a good catch from Brian Chari to send him home. Chatara bangs this into the ribs, Ashraf flicks it aerially towards mid-wicket. Chari stationed there dives forward and takes a nice diving catch. Pakistan lose another.
A low full toss on leg, the ball has struck him hard on his hand on the way to the keeper.
Some chin music for Ali once again, he lets that bouncer through to the keeper.

In the air... and what? No one goes for the catch? Perhaps a misjudgement from Wellington. A length ball in line of the sticks, Ali looks to clear the stadium with a mighty hit but ends up skying it up. The ball hangs in the air and goes towards mid-wicket where the two fielders look to get under it but none of them really go for it. As a result, a chance goes abegging.

FOUR! He is lining up these short balls really nicely. Donald tests him with a bumper targeting the grill, Ali is up to it as he swings his bat across the line and gets it in the gap towards square leg. A boundary results.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
A short ball in line of the stumps, Ali pulls it to mid-wicket and in the gap. Two runs are taken.
Donald Tiripano is back for another spell.
Full outside off, Ali lifts it to mid off and takes a single. A wicket and 11 runs off this over.
FOUR! What a booming drive from Ali. Gets a fuller ball and throws his bat at it. The ball races through the cover-point region for another boundary.

FOUR! Cut and cut hard. He is looking really nice out in the middle. A back of a length ball outside off, he gets into position and makes the bat meet the ball powerfully. A boundary results through the backward point region.

And one more short ball into the batsman, he hooks it up and over the short fine leg fielder. The ball goes towards the fence but Wellington from square leg runs to his right and stops the ball just inside the boundary. However, two runs are taken.
Another shortish delivery coming in to the right-hander who looks to cut it but misses.
Faheem Ashraf is the next batsman in.

OUT! Blessing is blessed with the centurion Imam-ul-Haq's wicket. He is congratulated on his way out. A nice pacy short ball outside off, Imam goes for the pull. The ball goes high in the air but doesn't get the desired distance on it. Musakanda at long on takes an easy catch and ends a wonderful innings from the youngster.
Another ball which Imam cannot connect. Chatara lands one fuller on leg, Imam misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. They steal a leg bye as the ball rolls to the on side.
That's better from Chatara. Another yorker on leg, Imam gives room and looks to work it on the on side but cannot make any contact.
Milks this through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Length ball, on off, just what Ali was waiting for. He waits for it and hoicks it over the mid-wicket boundary for a biggie.
Well bowled yorker on leg. Imam digs it out in time to the leg side for a run.
Hurls this full on middle and leg, Imam squeezes it to cow corner and sprints to complete the second run.
Outside off, played to point for nothing.
Ali was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
SIX! In the air.. and goes all the way. A maximum for the aggressive Ali. He gets under the fuller ball nicely and tonks it all the way over the long on fence.
On a length, pushed to mid off by Imam. He sets off for a run and his partner complies. A single is taken but it's a tight one.
Another short ball in line of the stumps, Imam moves away and slashes it over the infield. The batsmen come back for two.
Short, targeting the ribs of Imam who moves away to play it to the leg side but misses. The ball goes just wide of the leg stump and the umpire doesn't signal a wide either.
Blessing Muzarabani back on.
Another shortish delivery outside off, another angled bat face presented by the left-hander for a run.
Around off on a length, Ali opens the face of the bat and gets it to third man for a run.
Short and wide, Ali slashes at it from his crease and gets it fine to third man. Two runs are taken before the fielder cuts it and throws it back.
Strays on the pads this time, Ali flicks it from there and gets it to deep square leg. Two runs are taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, pushed to long on for another run.
Short and some room for Ali, he cuts it behind point and changes strike.
Ali works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Edged and four!  Ali gets a shortish delivery outside first up and he pokes at it. An edge is induced and the ball races to the third man fence.
Asif Ali is the next batsman.

OUT! Gone! Another 50-run stand and another wicket. Full and wide, Malik goes fetching and ends up getting an edge to the keeper. Tiripano and Zimbabwe rejoices as the batsman walks back to the pavilion with a grimace on his face.
Played through mid-wicket by Imam. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! On the hips from Donald, clipped fine to the leg side for a boundary.
Full around off, pushed to covers by Malik for a single.
Donald Tiripano comes in for a bowl.
Short and pulled to mid-wicket for another run.
On the pads, worked to the on side for a run.
Goes for a wild hoick again and misses it.
On the pads, pushed through mid-wicket by Imam. The batsmen scamper for two.
Charges down the track but misses the ball.
Outside off, short of a length, guided to third man for a run.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. 5 fielders are allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Tendai Chatara comes back into the attack.
Imam has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Flighted around off, pushed through covers by Malik to bring up the 50-run stand between the two. It's the third consecutive one for Pakistan in this innings.
On the pads, worked to the leg side for a run.
Imam gets to the pitch of the ball and connects.
Played through mid-wicket by Imam.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but Imam still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Wellington Masakadza will continue in the attack.
Imam has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Imam has decided it's time. A gentle length ball in line of the stumps, the batsman comes down the track and slogs it across the line through mid-wicket. A boundary results.
In line of the stumps, Malik punches it off the back foot to long on for another run.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for a run.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a run.
On a length around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Chamu Chibhabha comes in for another spell.
Rocks back and punches the ball through the off side for another run. Pakistan are on the charge now.
Imam works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Malik pushes it to covers off the front foot. One run taken.
Flatter on middle and leg, blocked to the on side.

SIX! Massive, massive hit this. A lofted delivery in line of the stumps, Malik comes down the track and goes through the line. The connection is such that it sails into the long on fence. First maximum of the innings for Pakistan.
Flighted around off, defended to the off side.
Drinks!

FOUR! Second ODI ton for Imam-ul-Haq! What style to bring it up too. He's had to grind it out for the most part in this knock, but he's toughened it out there and got to the milestone. Well deserved. Short ball and he pulls it through square leg for a boundary. He takes his helmet off, raises his bat in celebration. Hugs his partner out there in joy as well.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short of a length on leg stump, tucked away through square leg. One run taken.
Short ball banged in, bit too straight in line as Malik helps the pull down to fine leg. Single is earned.
Full delivery outside off, Imam plants his front foot forward and drives it neatly through the covers for one.

Good length delivery around off, Tiripano makes it go away, Imam with an angled bat steers this down towards third man. The placement is good, wide enough of the fielder there to allow him to come back for the second.
Full on the stumps, so full that the ball can't turn. Malik takes a big stride forward and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Good air on this from Wellington, Imam works it to mid-wicket. One run to the scoreboard.
Imam goes the same way, cuts it late down towards third man. He's able to come back for the second quite easily.
Short and flat outside off, cut down to third man for a single.
Drifting in with the arm, Malik works it wide of the mid-wicket fielder. Big space out there, two easy runs taken.

Tossed up on middle and leg, turning in, Imam kneels forward and across before paddle sweeping this fine down the leg side. Long boundary out there, it won't run away to the fence but it's enough to fetch them three runs.
Short of a good length outside off, punched from inside the crease to the off side.
Angling in, slightly ahead of a length, Malik works it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, cut comfortably down to third man. One run added to the total.
Switches to around the wicket, full and outside off, Imam fails to squeeze it out on the off side.
Keeps it full once more, attacks the stumps this time, it's guarded out safely by the batsman.
FOUR! He's welcomed with a boundary. Full and fired around off, Imam makes room, jumps out and hammers it nicely over mid off. Clears the infield with ease and finds the boundary.
Donald Tiripano returns to the attack.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Pushed past the cover region this time by Malik. Single taken.
Flighted delivery outside off, blocked softly in front of cover.
Shoaib Malik comes out next to bat.

OUT! GONE! Against the run of play too. Babar Azam was playing so well, he'll be disappointed he got out like this. Short ball, on the stump, Babar rocks back in a jiffy to pull this over mid-wicket. Doesn't get the height on it and it goes flat right to Chibhabha who takes a sharp catch. Partnership of 59 comes to an end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball attacking the stumps, nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
Hangs back and blocks it out.
Short and on leg, pulled down to fine leg for one.
Fraction straight in line, flicked fine down the leg side for a run.

Edged and DROPPED! A difficult chance, but a chance nonetheless. Ryan Murray did well though, but in such situations, you'd really want those to be taken. Muzarabani angles it away on a length around off, Imam hangs his bat out to block and gets an edge. It flies to the left of the keeper, who dives and gets a hand to it, but can't hold on to it. Single taken.
Flicked away on the leg side for a run.
Just behind a fuller length, in the off stump channel, Babar Azam taps it down in front of point.
Tapped away with the turn towards cover-point. A run to end the over.
Looks to make room but the bowler follows him. Is a little cramped for room so all he can do is nudge it down to short fine leg. Single collected.
Drives this full length ball down the ground to long off for a single.
Straighter one on the stumps, blocked from within the crease.
On the pads, nudged away through the square leg area for a run.
Full and slow with some drift on it, driven through mid off. Single taken.

Short of a good length, it's flicked with the wrists through square leg. The batsmen run hard and come back for the second, as the throw comes in to the bowler who takes the bails off. It's taken upstairs but Babar is safe by a good margin. Good running.
With an open bat face it's guided to third man. One run to the total.
FOUR! Pure class. That's a superb shot. Full and straight, Babar Azam presents the full face of the bat this time and caresses the drive through mid on for a boundary.
Some extra bounce off the deck, on a bit of a fuller length, Azam looks to flick but spoons a leading edge towards mid on.
Jagging back in off the deck, on a good length again, Babar stays behind the line to block.
Slanting away from a good length, around off, the southpaw runs it down to third man with an angled blade and takes one.
Blessing Muzarabani back on.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Imam moves a step across his sticks and works it down in front of square leg for a single.
Turns it away on the on side with gentle hands. Won't get any runs for it.
Short and bowled outside off, cut square through point for one more.
Short but not that short, as a result Babar mistimes the pull to the man at mid-wicket.
Nudges this through square leg and changes ends.
Sliding in with the arm, Babar use the angle and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide, cut away square on the off side for a double. 19 off the over, the most expensive one of this innings so far.
FOUR! Fourth in this over! Pakistan have maybe decided it's finally time to accelerate. Short on the stump, Imam pulls it over mid-wicket with power to send it across the boundary line.
FOUR! This is turning out to be an expensive over. 13 off the over so far. Tossed up on the stumps from around the wicket, Imam jumps out and lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Eased down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Already showing his class. Babar Azam finds the fence with ease. Short and wide again, needs no second invitation to go back and smash it through the covers again. Another boundary.
FOUR! Shot. Finds the gap with perfection. Short and wide, Babar goes back and slaps this through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Backs away, opens the face a bit and runs it down to short third man.
Slower through the air, full in length and turning, Azam is well forward to block that one out.
Works it off his pads and turns it on the leg side for a single.
A little short, Babar helps the pull to long on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Shot. A bit poor from Roche. He'll eventually learn. But, right now, he's paid the price. Dropped short again, Imam rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
Imam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Eased away to long on for one. It was full in length and quite slow through the air.
Comfortably defends it on the leg side. Dot ball.
Short again, Imam slaps the pull down to long on to rotate strike.
Roche darts it short and it turns it from outside off, Azam backs away and cuts it late. Beats the diving effort of the short third man fielder and gets three runs for it.
Positions himself right behind the line and blocks it back down the track.
Short and flat outside off, punched firmly through towards sweeper cover. Single to the total.
Comes down the track to negate the spin and pushes it past the bowler for a neat single.

Wonderful effort from Musakanda there. He's a livewire in the field. Babar Azam punches this to the covers, Musakanda moves to his left and dives full stretch to stop the ball. Gets up in a flash too and throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off. Fortunately for Imam, he made it in by then.
Nice and slow and full from Wellington, forces Azam forward to just defend.
Aims this on the pads, easy enough for Imam-ul-Haq to work it away through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket area for one.
Taps this fuller length ball which doesn't turn much in front of cover. End of a good over from Roche.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Knocks this full ball down the ground to long off and gets to the other end.
Off the mark straightaway. Babar moves inside the line and clips it away in front of square leg for a single.
Babar Azam, making a return after a wrist injury, makes his way out at no.3.

OUT! Zaman is out of here! Maiden ODI wicket for the debutant Liam Roche. Excellent reflexes to take this too. Well deserved. He gives this a lot of air and drops it just short of a driving length. Zaman charges out, looks to smash it past the bowler but hits it right at him. Roche reacts quickly and holds on to the catch. Zimbabwe have their first breakthrough, chance to make further inroads. 113-run stand is finally broken.
Floated full in length, close to off, Imam takes a step out and pushes it to long off for a run.
Maiden ODI fifty for Imam-ul-Haq! He's had to work hard for it. He flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single to get to the milestone. Must make it big now.
Picks it off his pads and works it away to the on side for a single.

FOUR! Plays it late and gets the desired result. Short and flat outside off, Zaman cuts it at the last moment and gets it fine past the keeper. Nobody out there in the deep so the ball rolls across the third man boundary.
Once again, played to the same fielder in the same region.
A similar delivery, slightly fullish in length, it's driven to mid on this time.
From around the wicket, it's flighted around leg stump, Fakhar Zaman makes room, gets a little cramped for room as he punches it towards mid-wicket.
Darted quicker, touch short in length, cut away to backward point to end the over. Imam is still stuck on 49.
Cut off the back foot through the cover region. One run taken.
Stays rooted inside the crease, waits for the ball to come to him before punching it in front of covers.
Pitches it up this time and provides some flight as well, Zaman drives it through covers for two runs.
Some width again offered outside off, played to point for no run.
Short, flat and turning away slightly outside off, cut away down to short third man.
Zaman goes down the ground too. It's full in length and he just eases it to long on for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Moves inside the line, not much spin on it and Imam works it away into the leg side for a couple.
Flighted delivery outside off, pushed to the cover area for one more.
Imam-ul-Haq comes forward and drives this through to long off for a single.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Wellington Masakadza introduced into the bowling attack.
Leans ahead and drives it through mid off for a single.
Fifty for Fakhar Zaman! His 5th in this format. Lovely batting, his good form in Zimbabwe continues. He just turns it on the leg side and gets to the other end.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Moves to 49 with that. Zaman makes good use of the feet, gets close to the pitch and drives it aerially through extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Zaman prods forward in defense.
On the pads again, Imam works it to fine leg for a couple.
Short and pulled away by Zaman. A run taken.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Stays inside the line of the ball and guides it through backward point for a single.

Nice effort by Muzarabani. A length ball around off, Zaman goes with his favorite vut and finds the gap. The ball races towards the fence but a diving effort in the deep stop it from crossing the boundary. Three runs are taken.
Starts with a length ball on the pads,Imam works it to leg side and changes strike.
Imam has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Shortish from Roche, Zaman moves his right leg to pull it but only manages a single from the mid-wicket region.
Flighted on off, Imam comes down the track and pushes it mid-wicket. One run results.
Hangs back on the back foot and pushes it tho on side for a single.
Guides this one through cover-point for two.
On the pads, pushed to mid-wicket for a run.
Zaman does well to leave that bouncer.
Full around off, driven to deep extra covers for another single.
Short and wide, Imam looks to cut but doesn't get the desired result.
Full on middle and leg. Pushed to mid on for nothing.
In line of the stumps, Zaman taps it to point. One run taken.
On leg pole, pushed to the on side by Zaman.
Time for a hot breather in the cold weather. Drinks time!
Zaman comes down the track and punches it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Toying with the bowler here. A flatter delivery just outside off, Zaman uses the pace and guides it through backward point and earns himself a boundary.
Zaman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another flat and short ball from Roche. Imam waits for it and pushes it through cover-point for a run.
Flatter on off, kept out by Imam.
Youngster starts with a shortish ball on off, Zaman pushes it through covers and takes a single.
Debutant Liam Nicholas Roche comes on for a bowl.
FOUR! Errs in line and dishes this one on the pads, Imam flicks it fine to the boundary and makes it a 7-run over for the visitors.
On the pads, flicked to square leg by Zaman. One run added to the total.
Swivels to play the back of a length ball to square leg. One run taken.
Stays in his crease and guides it to the point fielder for nothing.
Stays behind the line and punches it off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Imam works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

FOUR! And that is the beauty of singles. After five singles, a boundary makes it a 9-run over. A touch short around off, Zaman stays on the leg side and cuts it up and over the point region for a boundary.
Shortish ball on middle, pulled to square cut. Pakistan duo is happy to milk the bowler for singles as they take another one.
Not that short but Zaman pulls it to mid-wicket. Four singles in a row.
Guides the shortish ball to third man and takes third single in a row.
Outside off, cut through cover-point for another run.
Imam hops and blocks the ball to the on side. One run is taken.
Pushed to point by Zaman. Both the openers are taking it slow and playing themselves in for a longer innings perhaps.
On a length in line of the stumps, Zaman blocks it down the pitch.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single by Imam. 50-run stand is up between the duo.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out for nothing.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Almost chopped on by Zaman. A fullish ball in line of the stumps, Fakhar looks to chop it but gets a bottom edge. Luckily for him the ball bounces over the stumps.
Short outside off, slashed to third man for a single.
Outside off, cut to point for nothing.
A tad shorter in length, pulled away to mid-wicket for another run.
On a length on middle and off, Imam defends it.
Short outside off, guided uppishly to third man for a run.
Starts with a back of a length ball in line of the stumps. Zaman defends it back to the bowler.
Chamu Chibhabha comes on for a bowl.
Some chin music for Imam, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket keeper.
Imam shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a shortish length, blocked off the back foot for nothing.
FOUR! Another leg side ball, Imam gets into position and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
On the hips again, Zaman gets hits on the thigh pad and another leg bye is stolen from the on side.
On the hips and Imam misses out on a boundary as he gets hit on the thigh pad. A leg bye is stolen.
Donald Tiripano is the first change for the hosts.
A slower ball on the pads, Imam pushes it to the on side and takes a single.
Another short ball from Chatara, Zaman pulls it to square leg and changes strike.
On the hips, pulled mid-wicket for a single.
Drives the fullish ball to the cover region.
Around off this time, pushed to point.
Short ball, pulled to short mid-wicket for nothing.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled by the umpire. The restrictions have been lifted and Zimbabwe can have four fielders outside the 30-yard circle now.
Nicely played by Imam. A short of a length ball around off, Ul-Haq pushes it through cover-point. The ball races towards the boundary but a diving stop from the fielder saves a run for Zimbabwe.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Imam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A short of a length ball in line of the stumps, blocked off the back foot by Imam.
FOUR! Gets to the pitch of the delivery and creams it through covers for a boundary. An edge and a boundary.

Almost had him there. Another peach from Muzarabani. It lands on middle and swings away after pitching. Imam hangs his bat in anticipation but an outside edge is induced. However, the ball drops just in front of the fielder at second slip.
Around off, kept out down the track.
FOUR! Punished this time. A length ball around off, Zaman punches it from his crease and finds the gap between cover and point. A boundary results.
Hangs back and punches the shortish delivery to covers.
A touch short outside off, cut behind point for a run.
Wide outside off stump, Imam leaves it alone.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for nothing.
Punched off the back foot by Fakhar to end an exciting over.
Goes for the booming drive but misses the line altogether. The ball goes past the off pole.
FOUR! Easy picking for Zaman. A short ball in line of the stumps, Zaman pulls it through mid-wicket and earns a boundary for himself.
Zaman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish around middle and off, punched to mid on for nothing.
Fakhar goes after a wide one but misses.

Almost a run out here. A direct hit and Imam would have been gone. A run after 12 balls and almost produced a wicket for Zimbabwe. A length ball outside off, Zaman cuts it to the fielder at covers. There is a yes-no situation in the middle and Imam dives at the end to complete the run eventually. Risky stuff from both.
In the ribs from Chatara, Zaman hops and gets it to the on side for nothing.
A touch short this time, defended by Zaman.
Zaman defends it from within the crease.
Touch wider this time, Zaman drives it to mid off for nothing.
Full around off, punched to the off side.
Gets behind the line and blocks the back of a length ball back to the bowler. A good maiden over from Muzarabani.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
OMG! This is an absolute jaffa! This squared him up. On a length around middle and leg, it swings away from Imam who misses the ball once again.
Lovely stuff from Muzarabani. On a back of a length pitches on middle and leg and goes across the left-hander. Imam looks to defend but misses again.
Another play and a miss for Imam. Lucky for him he doesn't get any bat on the delivery angled across him.
In line of the stumps, kept out by the batsman.
Well bowled! A length ball targeting the stumps, Zaman gets his bat behind the line and keeps it out.
On the hips, easily clipped to fine leg for a run.
Similar line and length from Chatara, Imam punches it to covers.
Defends the shortish delivery to the on side.
Touch short in line of the stumps, kept out by Imam off the back foot.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! BANG! A full ball outside off, Zaman hits through the line and pierces the gap through covers for a boundary. This was middled properly by Zaman. Good finish to the over for the visitors.
Fullish around middle and off, Zaman gets it to point from the outer half.
Some swing on offer for Muzarabani. He lands this one around leg and angles it across. Zaman misses the line and gets hit on the pad.
Around off, left alone for the keeper.
Similar line and length from the bowler, Imam wrists it to the on side for another run.
On the pads, Zaman flicks it to square leg and changes strike.
On the pads, pushed to the on side for nothing.
FOUR! Nice and easy. A driveable length delivery outside off, Imam comes forward and drives it through covers for the first boundary of the Pakistan innings.
Some appeal from the bowler but the umpire doesn't agree. A length delivery this from Chatara, its jags back in after pitching and raps Imam on his back leg. Perhaps the height saved him.
On a length in line of the stumps, kept out with a straight bat.
On the pads, flicked to fine leg for a run.
Short outside off, cut behind point and the batsmen take two.
Tendai Chitara to continue from the other end.
What a beauty! Angled delivery across the left-hander on a back of a length, Imam looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. A good start from the hosts.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out.

In line of the stumps, pushed to mid-wicket for nothing.

A fullish ball on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a run.
Blessing Muzarabani will share the attack.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a brace. A good over from Chatara to start with.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Both sets of players are out in the middle. We're done with the national anthems and it's time for action! Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq is the opening pair for Pakistan. Tendai Chatara will take the new ball for Zimbabwe. Here we go...

There are debutants in both the playing XI's. Pakistan have Asif Ali playing his first game while Liam Roche and Ryan Murray get their respective caps for Zimbabwe. Babar Azam has also made a comeback after the nasty wrist injury in England.
Toss - Zimbabwe win the toss and choose to field.

On the other hand, the Men in Green are going in full strength. They have a few debutants for the first game, which should give them a good opportunity to make their case for the longer formats. Meanwhile, Solomon Mire misses out after suffering from an injury. It's cloudy and chilly here and the action will start soon, hang around!

Hello and welcome to the first ODI between Zimbabwe and Pakistan at Queens Sports Club, Bulawayo. After the dismal tri-series, the home team will be looking to make some amends in the 50-over format against the team from Asia. They have a new team altogether, which will be raring to go. After playing all the matches in Harare, both the teams will be looking to access the pitch and the conditions in Bulawayo.
